corpus_provenance.extraction_notes: Path B inline judgement via 6 parallel Sonnet 4.6 subagents (batches of 50 filings each). Item 1A texts pre-extracted by build_corpus_v2.py from cached EDGAR HTML; some firms (CSCO, V, WFC, XOM, WMT, MO, MRK) had partial Item 1A coverage where the extractor pulled MD&A/exhibit content instead — those filings were honestly scored at low severity reflecting the captured text. See per-batch agent reports for details.
